MeasuredTruthTableLookup.statement:

  PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair Computability.encodeBool look ∧
  PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair (fun x => x) split ∧

    PEqualNP.Library.DecidableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair R →

    ∀ (A B : Language Bool), PEqualNP.Library.NPHard A →
      ∀ (s : Polynomial Nat),

MeasuredCompressedTruthBoundary.result: ACCEPTED (check): PEqualNP.Outside.MeasuredCompressedTruthBoundary; axioms [propext, Quot.sound, Classical.choice]; kernel re-checked 4418 constants
MeasuredCompressedTruthBoundary.statement:
∀ (k : Nat) (q : List Bool → Fin k → List Bool)
    (t : List Bool → (Fin k → Bool) → Bool),
    (∀ i, PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime (fun x => x) (fun x => x) (fun x => q x i)) →
    (∀ a, PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime (fun x => x) Computability.encodeBool (fun x => t x a)) →
    ∃ (run : List Bool × List Bool → List Bool) (prune : Nat → List (List Bool) → List (List Bool)),
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair (fun x => x) run ∧
      (∀ (b : List Bool) (xs : List (List Bool)),
        let enc := fun a b : List Bool => List.replicate a.length true ++ false :: (a ++ b)
        run (b, xs.foldr enc []) = (prune b.length xs).foldr enc []) ∧
      ∀ (b : Nat) (xs : List (List Bool)), xs.Nodup →
        (prune b xs).Sublist xs ∧
        (prune b xs).length ≤ Nat.rec 1 (fun i m => 2 * ((i+1) * b * (2*m)) + 1) k ∧
        ∀ (S : Finset (List Bool)) (l r : List (List Bool)) (x : List Bool), S.card ≤ b → xs = l ++ x :: r →
          (∀ y ∈ l ++ [x], t y (fun i => decide (q y i ∈ S)) = true) →
          (∀ y ∈ r, t y (fun i => decide (q y i ∈ S)) = false) → x ∈ prune b xs

DirectionalTruthTableTrim.statement:
∀ (m : Nat) (l r : List (List Bool)) (w : List Bool)
    (touch value : List Bool → Bool) (default : Bool),
    ((l ++ w::r).filter touch).length ≤ m →
    (∀ y ∈ l ++ w::r, touch y = false → value y = default) →
    (∀ y ∈ l ++ [w], value y = true) →
    (∀ y ∈ r, value y = false) →
    let xs := l ++ w::r
    let ys := if default then xs.drop (xs.length - (m+1)) else xs.take m
    ys.Sublist xs ∧ ys.length ≤ m + default.toNat ∧ w ∈ ys

MeasuredBoundedTruthTableBoundary.statement:
∀ (k : Nat) (q : List Bool → Fin k → List Bool),
    (∀ i, PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime (fun x => x) (fun x => x) (fun x => q x i)) →
    ∃ (run : List Bool × List Bool → List Bool)
      (prune : Nat → List (List Bool) → List (List Bool)) (bound : Polynomial Nat),
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair (fun x => x) run ∧
      (∀ (b : List Bool) (xs : List (List Bool)),
        let enc := fun a b : List Bool => List.replicate a.length true ++ false :: (a ++ b)
        run (b, xs.foldr enc []) = (prune b.length xs).foldr enc []) ∧
      ∀ (b : Nat) (xs : List (List Bool)), xs.Nodup →
        (prune b xs).Sublist xs ∧ (prune b xs).length ≤ bound.eval b ∧
        ∀ (S : Finset (List Bool)) (T : (Fin k → Bool) → Bool)
          (left right : List (List Bool)) (x : List Bool), S.card ≤ b →
          xs = left ++ x::right →
          (∀ y ∈ left ++ [x], T (fun i => decide (q y i ∈ S)) = true) →
          (∀ y ∈ right, T (fun i => decide (q y i ∈ S)) = false) →
          x ∈ prune b xs

BoundedTruthTableBoundary.statement:

      ∀ (b : Nat) (xs : List (List Bool)), xs.Nodup →

        ∀ (S : Finset (List Bool)) (T : (Fin k → Bool) → Bool)
          (left right : List (List Bool)) (x : List Bool),

TruthTableBoundaryTrim.result: ACCEPTED (check): PEqualNP.Outside.TruthTableBoundaryTrim; axioms [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]; kernel re-checked 735 constants
TruthTableBoundaryTrim.statement:
∀ (m : Nat) (left right : List (List Bool)) (x : List Bool)
    (touch value : List Bool → Bool) (default : Bool),
    ((left ++ x :: right).filter touch).length ≤ m →
    (∀ y ∈ left ++ x :: right, touch y = false → value y = default) →
    (∀ y ∈ left ++ [x], value y = true) →
    (∀ y ∈ right, value y = false) →
    let xs := left ++ x :: right
    let ys := xs.take m ++ xs.drop (max m (xs.length - (m+1)))
    ys.Sublist xs ∧ ys.length ≤ 2*m + 1 ∧ x ∈ ys

LexPrefixQueryNP.statement:

PolynomialImageMembership.statement:

    ∃ matchImage : List Bool → Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime (fun x => x) Computability.encodeBool matchImage ∧
        ∀ (p k : List Bool) (xs : List (List Bool)),
          let consWord := fun a b : List Bool => List.replicate a.length true ++ false :: (a ++ b)
          matchImage (consWord p (consWord k (xs.foldr consWord []))) = true ↔
            ∃ x ∈ xs, f (p,x) = k
